title: Spectral project lifecycle
description: A spectral project is its own relational unit (Samples/Spectra/Features/Interpretations) — NOT the tabular dataset used by DATA/Data Analysis. See analysis/spectrometry/storage.py. This file documents create/list/get/delete together for maintainability rather than one file per method.

response.project: project.meta.json contents (id, name, workflow_type, created_at, sample_count, spectra_count, ...)
